title: PR #27: refactor: remove non-functional atc-contracts JavaScript wrapper
content:
State: closed
Merged: True
Draft: False

Remove the package.json wrapper that only executed `echo ... && exit 0` and `echo "no tests"`. The module is documented as native ATCLang/ATVM; production contract implementations are ATCLang and native execution is covered by the module's conformance/exec-chain gates. This removes a fake JS build surface without changing contract sources.
